caroline-menjivar.text: Menjivar's campaign site says she has "experienced housing instability" and wants to keep "fighting to rewrite the rules that help our working families build the future we deserve."

tony-rodriguez.text: Public safety: "fully fund the LAPD and LAFD. More cops, more firefighters, fewer excuses." Also: "There must be consequences for criminals and a well-thought-out revision of our penal system."
Wants to end "frivolous spending of taxpayer dollars on failed programs" and require public audits showing exactly where money goes.
Would protect small businesses by eliminating overregulation and protecting them from crime.
On education: "LAUSD schools are for teaching our children. Their parents must retain the right to raise them."
On homelessness: "Being homeless on the street is bad for the homeless and the city in general"; wants resources redirected from ineffective programs to tangible community needs.
Calls immigration "not a black and white issue" needing nuanced solutions and better coordination among local, state and federal agencies.
